vo.text: And this is how we write it. Number one!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Today, let's learn all about number one!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Number one is tall and straight, like a little stick.

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: One.

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: One!

vo.text: Your turn! Say one!

vo.text: Can you show me one finger? Hold it up high!

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: One finger! Like this!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Let's paint a one! Start at the top...

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: and go straight down. One!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Now you! Draw a one in the air with your finger. Top... straight down!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Once more, slowly. Start at the top...

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: and straight down. One!

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: I can do it! Look!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Ha ha! Leo, that one is wiggly, like a worm!

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: Oops! Again. Top, and straight down. One!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Perfect! A tall, straight number one!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Let's find things that come in one!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Up in the sky, there is one sun.

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: One sun!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: And at night, there is one moon.

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: One moon! Goodnight, moon!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Touch your face. How many noses do you have?

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: One nose! Beep, beep!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: And one mouth, for one big smile!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Look at Bobo. How many tails does he have?

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: One little tail! Wiggle, wiggle!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: This baby is one year old today. So the cake has...

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: One candle!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Happy birthday! Make a wish! Whoo!

vo.text: How do you say one, in French?

vo.speaker: narrator_fr
vo.text: Un !

vo.speaker: narrator_fr
vo.text: Un !

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Your turn! Un!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Game time! Find the number one!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Where is the one?

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: This one! The seven!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Seven has a little hat on top. One is just straight. Here!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Where is the one now?

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: There! Tall and straight!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Where is the one? Look closely!

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: That one! No hat. Just straight!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: How many ducks? One, or many?

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: One duck! Quack, quack!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Stars! One star, or many stars?

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Many stars! Twinkle, twinkle!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: And here? One balloon, or many balloons?

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: One!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Let's count. One, two, three, four, five!

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: Oh! Many balloons!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Which plate has one apple?

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: That one! One apple! Can I eat it?

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Ha ha! Okay, Bobo. One apple for you!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Crunch! One yummy apple!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Let's remember!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: How do we draw a one?

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: Start at the top, and go straight down!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: How many suns are in the sky?

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: One sun!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: How many noses do you have?

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: One nose!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: How do you say one, in French?

vo.speaker: narrator_fr
vo.text: Un !

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: What had one candle on top?

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: The birthday cake!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Now, show me one finger!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: One finger! Great job!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Let's say the number one rhyme!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: One, one, number one!

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: Top to bottom, now it's done!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: One, one, number one!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Your turn! One, one, number one!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Next time, we'll learn number two!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Bye bye, friends!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: See you next time, on Tiny Sparks!
